path=pathlib.Path("workspaces/repository-file-inventory-20261109/scan-one.py")

before='    result=gh("GET","repos/"+repo+"/git/trees/"+sha+"?recursive=1")\n    if result.get("truncated"):'
after='''    try:
        result=gh("GET","repos/"+repo+"/git/trees/"+sha+"?recursive=1")
    except RuntimeError as error:
        # GitHub's Trees endpoint can return 404 for the canonical empty tree.
        # The pinned commit tree SHA proves the repository is empty on this ref.
        if "HTTP 404" not in str(error):
            raise
        commit=gh("GET","repos/"+repo+"/git/commits/"+sha)
        if commit.get("tree",{}).get("sha")=="4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904":
            return {},0
        raise
    if result.get("truncated"):'''

def gh(m,p,payload=None):
 args=["gh","api","--method",m,"repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/"+p]
 if payload is not None:args+=["--input","-"]
 r=subprocess.run(args,input=json.dumps(payload) if payload is not None else None,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=70)
 if r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(r.stderr)
 return json.loads(r.stdout)

out=gh("PUT","contents/"+str(path),{"message":"Handle empty default branch in repository inventory","content":base64.b64encode(b).decode(),"sha":original["sha"],"branch":"main"})
